name: Kent Goodman
source:
"Good morning Sir! I'm very sorry, but I have to deliver these papers. Perhaps later?"

Kent is an overly kind and selfless psychiatric nurse who can't say no to any request. Because of this, many people take advantage of his hardworking nature, which often leaves him overworked and stressed. 

Kent manages Manson's and Jones' group therapy.

[Edited from [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/object-ward]Itch.io[/url]]
